note: Amplitude ratios are per-recording IQR of channel 0 divided by the median recording's IQR. Used to set a defensible amplitude-augmentation range.

normalisation_finding.observed: processed tensors: ST recordings have ~2x the channel-0 IQR of SC (median 1.86x vs 0.91x of the dataset median)
normalisation_finding.mechanism: kaggle_train_student_kd.py:414 applies a SINGLE global EEG_SCALE=15849.46 to every recording, so this cohort-level amplitude difference is not removed by normalisation and reaches the network intact
normalisation_finding.status: MEASURED, not diagnosed - it is a plausible contributor to the 0.106 SC-ST kappa gap, and per-recording robust scaling is the experiment that would test it
normalisation_finding.caution: per-recording scaling discards absolute amplitude, which is physiologically meaningful for N3 slow waves; it is an experiment, not an obvious fix
